newsitem.title: UK: Young Ridgeway appoints Quilter to manage funds.
newsitem.headline: Young Ridgeway appoints Quilter to manage funds.

text.p: Young Ridgeway & Associates, a UK firm of independent financial advisers (IFAs), has appointed Quilter & Co to manage some 17.5 million of its clients funds.
A statement said from Quilter said it was "the latest in a series of similar instructions we have received from IFAs".
Philip Ridgeway, chairman of the Surrey-based firm, said clients would benefit from "the greater resources and depth of expertise of Quilter at no additional cost".
"We will continue to monitor the performance of the investment manager...but this action enables us to devote more time to the advisory role we provide to our clients."
Quilter & Co is a subsidiary of Commercial Union and is regulated by the Securities and Futures Authority.
